title: Evaluate M4RIE for GF(2^m) references
description:
Determine whether M4RIE can be a hard reference for GF(2^m) matrix operations.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A reproducible M4RIE harness exists or a rejection note explains why it is not viable.
- [hard] The GF(2^m) target matrix uses or explicitly excludes M4RIE based on evidence.
